# Security Policy

## Fail-fast policy

This project follows a fail-fast policy. When dependency modules are updated, we follow those updates after we confirm that all tests pass.

## Minimum security measure

As a minimum security measure, this project requires unit tests, static analysis, and lint checks. Maintaining high test coverage is also a required condition.

## Vulnerability response

When a vulnerability is discovered or reported, we apply a fix as quickly as possible and release a patched version.

## Reporting a vulnerability

You may report vulnerabilities by opening an issue or by using the repository's private GitHub Security Advisory reporting flow.
